masterTemplate: Use case: product-mockup. Image 1 is the monument design reference, image 2 the BENGAL stone reference. Produce a clean single frontal product image, entire monument in Bengal stone. Preserve every structural shape and proportion, no invention. DESCRIPTION Camera exactly centered on longitudinal axis with no left/right yaw. Front engraving surface parallel to picture plane where present. Use parallel orthographic projection; modest elevation only to reveal base/slab, no three-quarter view. Entire object visible with balanced margins. Uniform pale grey background, soft contact shadow, polished stone with gentle studio lighting, no glare masking surfaces. Remove all text, optional engraved motifs, flowers, plants and removable vases. Preserve all structural cavities and fixed inserts. Single square image requested 2048x2048. Fixed geometry master for subsequent material-only variants.
variantTemplate: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is fixed geometry and framing master; image 2 is MATERIAL stone reference. Change ONLY all stone surfaces to reference material, preserving exact silhouette, every component, crop, camera, scale, shadows and plain grey background. Do not alter geometry, add parts, headstones, decorations, text, flowers or vases. Preserve cavities and fixed non-stone/metal parts unchanged. Faithfully match color, veins and realistic mineral grain scale of image 2. Soft polished highlights without obscuring engraving areas. Single square image requested 2048x2048.
